items.name: Legacy Rescue Lab
items.text: Legacy Rescue Lab: Legacy Rescue Lab is an Evercraft legacy software rescue and modernization capability. Common needs: my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy; our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works; our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky; customers cannot submit our lead form.
